IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Farrell, Zeiger, Pike, Ryu, Riccelli, and Pollet

Bill.BriefDescription: Coordinating the removal of fish passage barriers.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to coordinating the removal of fish passagebarriers; and adding a new section to chapter 47.01 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.01 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) When determining the prioritization of fish passage barrierremovals for each fiscal biennium, the department must regularlyconsult with the department of fish and wildlife, the department ofnatural resources, state parks, appropriate local governments, regionalfishery enhancement groups, forest landowners, and appropriate tribesto identify existing fish passage barriers on state highways where theremoval of such barriers by the department may occur in conjunctionwith projects sponsored by these entities. When such an opportunity isidentified, to the greatest extent practicable, the department mustcoordinate with the sponsoring entity in order to remove the implicatedfish passage barrier in a manner that achieves the greatest cumulativecost savings to the department and the sponsoring entity. (2) The department must provide a report to the transportationcommittees of the legislature by January 15th of each year regarding p. 1 HB 2346the fish passage barrier projects in which the department coordinatedwith a sponsoring entity, the savings associated with the coordination,and any recommendations for improvements to the coordination process.
